name: Voice Memo to Tasks
description: Messy thinking out loud, cleaned up into a short summary plus a task list.
outline: Write a two or three sentence clean summary of what the speaker was thinking about.
Extract every task, reminder or intention as a '- [ ] ' checkbox line, rewritten to start with a verb.
Collect ideas that are not tasks in a separate list.
Drop filler words, repetition and false starts.
Keep the speaker's own words for names, places and numbers.
example:
## Tasks
- [ ] Call the plumber about the leak
- [ ] Renew the car insurance
